German-Speaking Technical Customer Support Advisor 
 Location: Bucharest, Romania
 Work Model: On-site for the first 3 months, with hybrid working available afterwards based on performance
 Employment Type: Full-time
 We are partnering with a global customer experience company that supports a leading home appliances brand to recruit three German-Speaking Technical Customer Support Advisors for its team in Bucharest, Romania.
 This is an excellent opportunity for German-speaking professionals who enjoy helping customers, solving technical problems, and delivering outstanding customer service. You will provide voice-based technical support to German-speaking customers, helping them resolve product-related issues and get the most out of their home appliances.
Key Responsibilities 
Provide technical customer support in German via phone.
Assist customers with enquiries and issues relating to home appliance products.
Diagnose and troubleshoot technical and product-related problems.
Guide customers through troubleshooting procedures and provide clear, accurate solutions.
Identify customer needs and ensure a positive support experience.
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, technical issues, and resolutions.
Escalate complex cases to the appropriate teams when necessary.
Meet established quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction targets.
 Requirements 
German language proficiency at C1 level or above .
Previous customer service or technical support experience is an advantage.
Good technical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
A customer-focused attitude with strong communication skills.
Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
Confidence using computer systems and internal support tools.
Ability to work effectively in a structured, target-driven environment.
Willingness to work on-site in Bucharest for the first three months.
Legal right to work in Romania or a valid work permit.
 What We Offer 
Competitive remuneration based on experience, skills, and performance.
Relocation assistance for eligible international candidates relocating to Romania.
Sign-on bonus for new joiners.
Performance-based bonus opportunities.
Meal allowance.
Medical subscription.
Wellbeing programmes and employee support initiatives.
Training, guidance, and access to the tools you need to succeed.
 Hybrid working opportunities after the first three months, subject to performance. 
Additional employee benefits and development opportunities.
 Interested in This Opportunity? If you speak German at C1 level or above and are looking for an opportunity to develop your technical support career with an internationally recognised home appliances brand, we would love to hear from you.
 Apply now to take the next step in your career!
